{{CharInfobox| color={{emerald color light}} | corecolor={{white color}} | bordercolor={{emerald color}} | name=Montgomery | jname=マサオミ | tmname=Masaomi| slogan=no | image=Montgomery.png | size=250px | caption=Montgomery | colors=yes| eyes=Lilac| hair=Green| gender=Male | hometown=Unknown| region=[[Unova]] | trainer=yes | trainerclass={{pkmn|Trainer}} | game=no | leader=no | team=no | brain=no | anime=yes | epnum=BW070 | epname=The Clubsplosion Begins!| java=Miyu Irino| enva=Nicholas DiMichele }} '''Montgomery''' (Japanese: '''マサオミ''' ''Masaomi'') is a recurring character of {{aniseries|BW}} who first appeared in ''[[BW070|The Clubsplosion Begins!]]'' and a rival of [[Stephan]]. ==History== ===''Pokémon the Series: Black & White''=== Montgomery was the champion of the previous year's [[Clubsplosion]] tournament and returned to defend his title with his {{p|Throh}}. He showed a particular interest in [[Stephan]] and his {{TP|Stephan|Sawk}}. However, when Stephan began bragging that Sawk was the greatest, he took slight offense to it. He stated that Stephan could not say he was the greatest until he won a {{pkmn|battle}} against his Throh. Even then, he concluded that Stephan would not make it past the second round just by looking at Sawk. Still, Montgomery continued to observe Stephan and Sawk in ''[[BW071|Search for the Clubultimate!]]'' during the intermission while they were attempting to help [[Ash's Scraggy]] direct his {{m|Focus Blast}}. Afterwards, Montgomery fought his first opponent [[Delbert]], defeating him easily and advancng to the second round. [[File:Montgomery and Stephan.png|thumb|left|250px|Montgomery and Stephan]] The night before the second round was to begin, in ''[[BW072|A Clubsplosion of Excitement!]]'', Montgomery was seen training Throh by having him throw large boulders around. Ash asked him to train with him and Stephan, but he refused, saying that he did not train with his "enemies". The next day, he went up against {{an|Iris}} and her {{TP|Iris|Excadrill}} and won, advancing himself to the semifinals. Before the episode's conclusion, it was revealed that his opponent for that round would be Ash and he battled him in ''[[BW073|Commanding the Clubsplosion Crown!]]''. Montgomery was well aware of how badly Scraggy aimed his {{m|Focus Blast}} attacks and did not issue a command to Throh. Instead, they waited as all of his Focus Blasts missed. He finally told Throh to attack after Scraggy used {{m|High Jump Kick}}, and Ash was quickly defeated. As a result, Montgomery would join Stephan in the final round of the Clubsplosion. Stephan proved to be his toughest opponent, to the point where Montgomery struggled to maintain control of the battle. As a result, he eventually lost, forcing him to give up his championship title. Though he lost, he was thoroughly impressed by Stephan's skills as a Trainer and congratulated him when he won, even giving him a handshake. He said that the next time he and Stephan battled, he would be victorious. ==Character== Montgomery is incredibly confident in his skills as a {{pkmn|Trainer}}, though comes off as cold and distant. He has honed his {{p|Throh}}'s stamina to allow him to take control of any match, dealing ultimate damage at close range. Montgomery takes particular offense to overconfidence, and will wait out an opponent before responding with a barrage of attacks. ==Pokémon== This listing is of Montgomery's known Pokémon in {{aniseries|BW}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Montgomery |pkmn=Throh |gender=male |type1=Fighting |img=Montgomery Throh.png |epnum=BW070 |epname=The Clubsplosion Begins! |vajp=Unshō Ishizuka |vaen=Scott Williams |desc={{p|Throh}} is the only known Pokémon Montgomery has on hand and had started a rivalry with [[Stephan's Sawk]]. In ''[[BW071|Search for the Clubultimate!]]'', he went up against Delbert's {{p|Mienshao}} and was able to dodge every single one of its attacks. He knocked it out of the tournament after a Seismic Toss followed by a Circle Throw. In ''[[BW072|A Clubsplosion of Excitement!]]'', Throh was put up against [[Iris's Excadrill]]. He managed to easily block Excadrill's attacks and finished him by using Seismic Toss, knocking the Subterrene Pokémon out and eliminating Iris from the tournament. After seeing Iris worry about Excadrill, Throh bowed his head in an apologetic fashion. In ''[[BW073|Commanding the Clubsplosion Crown!]]'', Throh's opponent in the semi-final round was [[Ash's Scraggy]]. Throh proved too powerful for the Shedding Pokémon and defeated him, eliminating Ash and advancing Montgomery to the final round where he would face off against Stephan's Sawk. Both Pokémon proved to be powerful, but Stephan's Sawk eventually emerged the victor after a great struggle once Throh fainted from exhaustion. Throh's known moves are {{m|Superpower}}, {{m|Seismic Toss}}, {{m|Circle Throw}}, and {{m|Bind}}.}} ==Pokémon competitions== Montgomery has competed in the following {{cat|Pokémon competitions}}: * [[Clubsplosion]] - Winner (one year before ''[[BW073|Commanding the Clubsplosion Crown!]]'') * [[Clubsplosion]] - Runner-Up (''[[BW073|Commanding the Clubsplosion Crown!]]'') ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{emerald color light}}|bordercolor={{white color dark}} |ja=入野自由 ''Miyu Irino'' |en=Nicholas DiMichele |fr_eu=Romain Barbieux |cs=Vojtěch Hájek |no=Erik Skøld |pl=Kamil Kula ([[BW070]]-[[BW072]])
